messages:
kevin: Quick convo: propose a narrow "offline-proxy" contract for Private that only permits inference (no streaming, no function-calls) and an explicit manifest to opt in. Keep it deliberately small.

lina: Yes. Manifest should declare allowed_ops, max_rps, manifest_version (sha256) and an audit_forwarding flag.

harpreet: Security note: default must be kms_passthrough=false. If customer opts into key use, require signed consent token and log proof.

ops-bot: DeployBot: private/zone-b runtime lost control-plane heartbeat at 6123450048 — offline-proxy active.

mika: Runtime behavior: after 90s of miss -> flip to offline, publish metric redwood.serving.mode=offline and respond with 422 + machine-readable JSON for unsupported ops so SDKs can retry/upgrade.

kevin: Action: I'll draft RFC with schema + error contract. @lina add telemetry labels. @harpreet draft consent flow. Canaries on Dedicated first.

lina: ack.

harpreet: ack, will include runbook for reverting when control-plane returns.

kevin: Thanks, posting RFC soon.
